blocks.text: The conspiracy behind half the Reach's misfortunes. This entire entry is **GM-only**: players never see it in lists, graph, timeline, search, or exports until you reveal it.

The Hand descends from the court sorcerers who drowned Maro with [[The Hollow Crown]] during [[The Drowning War]]. They believe the drowning was interrupted, not finished. They bankroll [[Kestrel Vane]]'s salvage runs, hold [[Ilsa Corvin]]'s leash, and burned the harbor archive on the [[Night of Broken Lanterns]] to destroy the one map of the [[Undercrypt of Maro]]'s outer galleries.
